configuration:
workflow:
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "codex/mqtt-runner-hardware-probe"'
    - when: never

stages: [hardware]

.hardware:
  stage: hardware
  image: ubuntu:24.04@sha256:78d4744ead1f5b19b04d0df558ab182a5300903900755e515b2ca4d10eb2044d
  timeout: 5m
  variables:
    GIT_STRATEGY: none
  before_script: []
  script:
    - |
      set -eu
      case "$CI_RUNNER_ID" in
        6|11|14) ;;
        *) echo 'Runner outside general-build inventory; hardware read skipped.'; exit 0 ;;
      esac
      probe_directory="hardware/$CI_RUNNER_ID-$CI_JOB_ID"
      mkdir -p "$probe_directory"
      {
        printf 'runner_id=%s\njob_id=%s\n' "$CI_RUNNER_ID" "$CI_JOB_ID"
        printf 'runner_arch=%s\n' "${CI_RUNNER_EXECUTABLE_ARCH:-unknown}"
        awk -F: '/^model name/ {sub(/^ /,"",$2); print "cpu_model=" $2; exit}' /proc/cpuinfo
        uname -srm
        printf 'online_cpus='; getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN
      } | tee "$probe_directory/identity.txt"
      for cpu_file in /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max /sys/fs/cgroup/cpuset.cpus.effective /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.cfs_quota_us /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.cfs_period_us; do
        if [ -r "$cpu_file" ]; then
          printf '%s=' "$cpu_file" >> "$probe_directory/allocation.txt"
          cat "$cpu_file" >> "$probe_directory/allocation.txt"
        fi
      done
      cat "$probe_directory/allocation.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
  artifacts:
    when: always
    expire_in: 1 week
    paths: [hardware/]

hardware_dind:
  extends: .hardware
  tags: [dind]

hardware_general:
  extends: .hardware
  parallel: 4
conclusion: All sampled general x64 runners (6, 11, 14) are Threadripper PRO 5975WX with two visible CPUs. None supplies the required Intel Xeon 8370C proof; shared-runner isolation is not established.
